summary: End-to-end testing of AML Detection Platform. 13/13 backend pytest tests passed (auth, stats, transactions+filters, tx detail with DL/NLP/graph analysis, alerts list+patch, graph network ego subgraph, SAR create+list, scan/run, unauthorized). Frontend flow verified: login -> dashboard KPIs (171 tx, 50 flagged, 49 open alerts), Run Detection Scan, Transactions table (171 rows), Investigation page (50 flagged tx in side list, network-graph rendered, File SAR works), Alerts (50 rows, Review status update works), SARs page lists filed SAR, Logout returns to /login. No JS console/page errors.

ui_bugs.issue: When navigating from Transactions row of a non-flagged tx, page shows 'No flagged tx' and 0 nodes/0 edges in graph (graph endpoint with that account returns empty subgraph). Recommend falling back to flagged-only view or showing the selected tx context.

After clicking Review (status -> under_review) the alert row is re-rendered without a 'Resolve' button until the status filter is changed; alert-resolve-{id} not visible for under_review rows in default 'open' filter.

action_items: (Optional UX) Investigation page: when ?tx= refers to a non-flagged tx, still render the selected tx detail and an ego graph instead of showing empty state.
(Optional UX) Alerts page: keep Resolve button visible for under_review rows OR auto-switch the filter after Review is clicked.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 618-line module mixing auth, seeding, detection, and routes. Recommend splitting into routes/, detection/, models/, auth/ for maintainability.
run_full_scan rebuilds the NetworkX graph for every transaction inside graph_score (O(N^2)); for 171 tx this is fine but it will not scale. Build the graph once and pass it in.
GET /api/transactions/{tx_id} calls Emergent LLM (gpt-4o-mini) on every request -- no caching. Repeated investigation views will incur cost/latency. Consider caching nlp result per tx.
Alert reasons concatenate signals but never include the NLP LLM 'explanation'; consider surfacing it on the detail page.
/api/scan/run wipes all alerts every run, losing operator notes/review status. Consider upsert by transaction_id.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 171 Zimbabwean tx incl. structuring, layering chain, fan-out patterns on first startup. One TEST_ SAR was created during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 13 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py pass against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend flows verified via Playwright. Any retest just needs to run pytest and the same login flow. Investigation page renders properly only when ?tx= points to a flagged transaction.
